news.title: OBA FEMI IS BEING CALLED OVERRATED AND OVERHYPED
news.body:
Oba Femi has been called overrated and overhyped by the IWC because of his recent victory over Bronson Reed. Oba took a brass knuckle punch and a tsunami and still kicked out leaving the IWC to wonder whether Oba Femi is being overpushed. The hate is going around.
He beat Brock Lesnar with one fall from grace and this makes fans think he is overrated.
But we all know he isn't overrated.

news.title: EDGE HAS ANNOUNCED HIS RETIREMENT FROM WRESTLING AFTER 32 YEARS
news.body:
Adam Copeland (Edge) already had one career taken away from him. This time, he gets to choose how the story ends.

The wrestling legend has announced that 2027 will be his final year in professional wrestling, saying he can feel himself “aging out” of the business and knows the finish line is getting closer. The announcement came after he qualified for AEW’s Clockwork Carnage match at WrestleDream.

For Copeland, retirement carries extra weight. A serious neck condition forced him to walk away in 2011, seemingly ending his career for good. Then, against the odds, he returned to the ring in 2020 and was given years of wrestling he once thought he had lost.

He finally had one last run with his best friend Christian before he calls it a career.

He already came back from an ending once. In 2027, Adam Copeland finally gets to write his own.
